title: Process Activity event (process-creation telemetry for ransomware triage and incident timeline collation)
summary: OCSF Process Activity events consumed on two surfaces: ransomware_containment reads process-creation records on the affected host at the triage step — PowerShell / WMI / vssadmin / wbadmin invocations and their parent chains — to confirm the ransomware signal before isolation fires, and again at EDR isolation to scope which host to isolate; post_incident_review reads the same class at timeline collation to reconstruct what executed where during the incident window. Consumed, never emitted: the records come from the operator's EDR / endpoint sensor, not from the playbooks.
sources: OCSF v1.4.0 System Activity category — Process Activity class (uid 1007)
